bom.item: Holybro X650 V2 frame kit (frame only)
bom.stock: Listed as available; ships from Hong Kong
bom.notes: Plates, 20 mm carbon arms with folding joints, landing gear, 10 mm rails, battery straps. No motors, ESCs, PDB or props. US reseller RMRC: $321.50, on backorder to about Dec 2026 (Options).

bom.item: T-Motor MN4014 KV400 motor
bom.notes: 171 g, 4-8S. Thrust stand: 3.0 kg per motor at full throttle with 16×5.4 props on 6S.

bom.item: Holybro Tekko32 F4 45A ESC (AM32)
bom.stock: In stock as single units; 4-pack sold out
bom.notes: The ESC in Holybro's own X650 kit. DShot and current sensing. Fit the supplied 330 µF capacitor on 6S. Replaces the $39.99 T-Motor AIR 40A planning price.

bom.item: T-Motor P16×5.4 polished carbon propellers, pair (CW + CCW)
bom.notes: Two pairs per aircraft: one flight set plus one spare set.

bom.item: Holybro PM08-CAN power module, XT90 connectors
bom.notes: 2-14S, 200 A continuous, DroneCAN, two 5.3 V / 3 A outputs. Replaces the bundle's PM02D, whose leads are rated 30 A.

bom.item: Holybro power distribution board 60 A, XT30 pre-soldered
bom.notes: 60 A continuous, 120 A for under 60 s; the motors draw about 90 A only at full throttle. The PDB in UCLA's bundle could be reused instead.

bom.item: Amass XT90-S anti-spark connectors, 5 pairs
bom.notes: Anti-spark plug on the aircraft's battery lead; spares for the packs and the charge lead.

bom.item: Pololu D24V150F12 step-down regulator, 12 V 15 A (blower supply)
bom.stock: In stock (92); Pololu marks it rationed
bom.notes: The blower needs 12 V at up to 5 A (60 W). The regulator's enable pin is switched from a Pixhawk output, with an RC cut-off.

bom.item: Lumenier 10,000 mAh 6S 25C LiPo, XT90
bom.stock: Add to cart; US stock, ground shipping
bom.notes: 1,245 g, 172 × 70 × 48 mm, XT90 already fitted. 76 g lighter than the pack used in the sizing. Cheaper alternative: Tattu 30C (Options).

bom.item: ARK Flow: optical flow, 30 m downward rangefinder and IMU (DroneCAN)
bom.stock: In stock; made in the USA
bom.notes: Velocity and height above the canopy. NDAA-compliant.

bom.item: ARK DIST LR: upward time-of-flight rangefinder, 80 m (DroneCAN)
bom.notes: Clearance to the roof and the lights. The 30 m DIST SR ($180) would also cover a 3-5 m roof (Options).

bom.item: LightWare SF45/B scanning lidar (50 m, 320°)
bom.notes: Obstacle ring for PX4 collision prevention. Longest lead time: order first.

bom.item: Holybro depth-camera mount for the 10 mm rails
RadioMaster R81 receiver (FrSky D8, SBUS)
bom.notes: Placeholder: the receiver must match UCLA's transmitter. ExpressLRS receivers cost about $20-40.

bom.item: Dronetag Beacon broadcast Remote ID
bom.notes: Needed only if the outdoor leg between tunnels is a Part 107 flight. 16 g, own battery and GNSS.

bom.item: Spare T-Motor MN4014 KV400 motor
Spare Holybro Tekko32 F4 45A ESC
Releaser quick-release mount: carbon plate, standoffs, latch, vibration isolators
bom.notes: Sized once the releaser's mounting points are known.

bom.item: Sensor brackets and lidar mast: carbon tube and plate, printed parts
Power wiring: 10-12 AWG silicone wire, XT30 pigtails, 12 V inline fuse, heat-shrink
Harness and small parts: JST-GH cables, vibration dampers, fasteners, LED and buzzer

reused.item: Holybro Pixhawk Jetson Baseboard Bundle: Pixhawk 6X, Jetson Orin NX 16 GB, case, 512 GB NVMe, Wi-Fi/BT, IMX219 camera, PM02D, UBEC 12A, PDB
reused.notes: The brief lists a Pixhawk 6X. The 6X Pro version is SKU 20338 at $2,759; without the case, SKU 20281 at $2,279.
A tariff surcharge has applied to store orders since 3 Feb 2026.
Outdoor backup only: no GPS in the tunnels.

reused.item: Holybro SiK Telemetry Radio V3, 100 mW, 915 MHz (pair)
Holybro UBEC 12A (3-14S), set to 7.2 V for the Jetson baseboard
reused.notes: Comes in the bundle above; the price is for a spare.
If UCLA has none: RadioMaster TX16S Mk II, $219.99 (Options).

options.text: Second autonomy set, so the X500 keeps flying: bundle, D455, M10 GPS and SiK radio (Reused sheet, rows 1-4)
options.notes: Only if UCLA's set cannot move to the new aircraft.

options.text: ARK DIST SR (30 m) instead of the DIST LR
options.notes: 30 m is plenty for a 3-5 m tunnel roof.

options.text: ARK DIST MR (50 m) instead of the DIST LR
Tattu 10,000 mAh 6S 30C, EC5 plug, instead of the Lumenier packs
options.stock: Official US store; ships from the USA
options.notes: 1,350 g each (105 g heavier). The EC5 plug must be swapped for an XT90 (connectors in BOM line 7).

options.text: X650 frame kit from a US reseller instead of Holybro
options.notes: Ships from Ohio, with no import duties to handle.

options.text: 6S charger, if UCLA has none: ISDT K2 Air
options.notes: Two channels. On AC (200 W) a 10 Ah pack takes about 1.3 h; with a DC supply, up to 500 W per channel.

options.text: RC transmitter, if UCLA has none: RadioMaster TX16S Mk II, ExpressLRS
options.notes: Pair it with an ExpressLRS receiver instead of the R81.

options.text: RealSense D456 (IP65, dust-tight) instead of reusing UCLA's D455
options.notes: For dusty tunnels. Same optics as the D455.

options.text: Livox Mid-360 3-D lidar for lidar-inertial navigation
options.notes: 265 g, 6.5 W, Ethernet; mount and cable about $50 more. Livox is DJI-affiliated: check NDAA/ASDA rules if federal funds are involved.
